feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956

summary.intent: Let zsh users load ripgrep's completion with `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` without the `_arguments ... can only be called from completion function` error, while keeping the installed `_rg` file and the CI option check working, and document both setups in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Fits issue #2956. When compinit has already run, sourcing the generated script now registers `_rg` for `rg` and `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>` completes. Before this change, the same setup printed the issue's error and completed nothing. Two problems remain in the new FAQ text, both `consider`.
summary.coverage: Reviewed both changed files in full at 855bfa6 against merge-base 79cbe89, plus the generator (`crates/core/flags/complete/zsh.rs`) and `ci/test-complete`. The clone's untracked `.mcp.json` is outside the committed range and was not reviewed. An independent verifier confirmed both findings and upheld both compatibility premises: fpath autoloading and the CI test's sourcing path behave as they did at base.
check_details: Reviewer-executed: scratch zsh 5.8.1 runs (zpty-driven `zsh -d -i`, system `_rg` filtered out) at 855bfa6. Sourcing after compinit completes `complete-zsh`; the same at base prints `_arguments:comparguments:325: can only be called from completion function`. fpath autoload completes at head and at base. A verbatim `$ source ...` line prints `command not found: $`. Sourcing before compinit prints `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments`. An fpath line placed after compinit gives no completion.
Reviewer-executed: reproduced `ci/test-complete`'s `get_comp_args` sourcing (emulate options, `_RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1`). Base and head both emit 341 identical spec lines.
Unavailable: `ci/test-complete` end to end and `cargo build`/`cargo test`, because no built `rg` and no vendored registry are available offline. No supplied CI evidence.

findings.title: Drop the `$ ` prompt from the zshrc source line
findings.trigger: A reader follows the FAQ and pastes `$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` verbatim into `$HOME/.zshrc`, as the preceding sentence instructs.
findings.impact: Every new shell prints `command not found: $` and rg completions are never registered, which defeats the one-liner this change adds.
findings.change: Write the line as `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` without the `$ ` prefix, as the `fpath=(...)` zshrc snippet just above it already does.
findings.source: PR body: "you can dynamically source completions in zsh"; FAQ.md:131-132 says to add the snippet to `$HOME/.zshrc`.

findings.title: Say where the zshrc lines go relative to compinit
findings.trigger: A reader adds the new `fpath=($HOME/.zsh-complete $fpath)` line after `compinit` (or after a global compinit such as Ubuntu's `/etc/zsh/zshrc`), or adds the `source <(...)` line before `compinit` or in a zshrc without it.
findings.impact: In the fpath case rg completion silently never loads. In the source case the new guard falls through to `_rg "$@"` because `compdef` is undefined, so every shell start prints `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments` and nothing is registered.
findings.change: In the FAQ's zsh section, state that the `fpath` line must come before `compinit` and that the `source` line must come after `compinit` has been loaded.
